crossRefs.note: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth, before the evil days come, and the years draw near, when you will…
“Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel didn’t remember Yahweh their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
translations.bsb: The Israelites failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
translations.asv: And the children of Israel remembered not Jehovah their God, who had delivered them out of the hand of all their enemies on every side;
